'''2010 US East Nationals Matthew Brown DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Brown]] at [[2010 US East Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hunt Down Jedi and Destroy Things
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
